description: Decay factors of STANDARD v1.1.0 section 8.1. The section requires the factor to be 0.5 at an age of one half-life and recommends (SHOULD) 0.5 ** (age / half_life); the vectors at other ages follow that formula, which schemas/authority_trust_model.yaml states as recency_factor. decay_model.min_trust, when the model sets it, is a floor on this factor. Each expected value is the value of that formula, written to the precision of a binary64 number. `not_covered` lists the cases the vectors leave out because the Standard does not state their result, each with what the reference implementation does; a vector for one of them would make one reading look required. grounded_agency/trust.py is the reference implementation; tests/test_trust.py runs it against this file.

fields.name: The vector's name, unique in this file.
fields.half_life: decay_model.half_life: an ISO 8601 duration of whole days, as schemas/authority_trust_model.yaml writes it.
fields.min_trust: decay_model.min_trust. Absent: the model sets no floor.
fields.age_hours: The age of the observation, in hours.
fields.decay_factor: The expected decay factor. A conforming value differs from it by at most `tolerance`.

not_covered: A min_trust above 0.5. Section 8.1 requires a factor of 0.5 at one half-life and makes min_trust a floor on the factor; with a floor above 0.5 both cannot hold. The reference implementation returns max(0.5 ** (age / half_life), min_trust), the recency_factor of schemas/authority_trust_model.yaml and the benchmark scenario benchmarks/scenarios/conflicting_sources.py, which is min_trust at one half-life.
An age below zero, for an observation dated in the future. Section 8.1 does not say what it decays to, and the formula gives a factor above 1. The reference implementation refuses it.

A half-life in another form than P<n>D. Section 8.1 says the half-life is configurable and gives no format; tools/validate_canonical_schemas.py accepts P<n>D with n at least 1 only, and so does the reference implementation.

vectors.name: no_age
vectors.about: An observation made now has lost nothing.

vectors.name: one_half_life
vectors.about: At an age of one half-life the factor is 0.5. A time constant, exp(-age / half_life), gives 0.3679 here and does not conform.

vectors.name: half_an_hour
vectors.about: An age that is a fraction of an hour: 0.5 ** (0.5 / 240).

vectors.name: floor_reached
vectors.about: With the shipped values, half_life P10D and min_trust 0.25, the factor reaches the floor at two half-lives: 0.5 ** 2.

vectors.name: floored_at_three_half_lives
vectors.about: 0.5 ** 3 is 0.125, below min_trust: the factor is min_trust.

vectors.name: floored_at_a_hundred_years
vectors.about: Age alone never takes the factor below min_trust.

vectors.name: no_min_trust_at_three_half_lives
vectors.about: The model sets no min_trust, so nothing floors the factor: 0.5 ** 3.

vectors.name: half_life_of_one_day
vectors.about: The half-life is configurable. With P1D, 36 hours are one and a half half-lives: 0.5 ** 1.5.

vectors.name: half_life_of_thirty_days
vectors.about: With P30D, 720 hours are one half-life.
